shots.alt: Brickworks on a phone in Simple: Simple pressed beside Full in the header, Save and Share dimmed at the top left over an empty 16 by 16 green plate, and the tray along the foot: twelve colours in two rows, the tabs Bricks, Plates, Slopes, Tiles and Specials, six bricks, and Undo and Redo above it.
shots.caption: Simple on a phone: a new model starts on a plate that fills the view.

shots.alt: A little red, yellow and blue house with a white roof on a 16 by 16 baseplate in Simple on a phone, one roof slope selected, Save and Share at the top left, and the round Turn, Copy and Delete buttons up on the right over the tray.
shots.caption: A tap on a part selects it: Turn, Copy and Delete come up beside it.

shots.alt: Brickworks on a computer in Simple: the header with the Brickworks mark and Simple pressed beside Full, Save and Share dimmed at the top left, the empty plate in the middle of the view, and the tray along the foot with its twelve colours in one row, the five group tabs and six bricks.
shots.caption: The same Simple on a computer: the mouse is a finger, and Full is one click away.
